evidence.evidence_text: Work on personality detection has tended to incorporate psychological features from different personality models, such as BigFive and MBTI.
Work on personality detection has tended to incorporate psychological features from different personality models, such as BigFive and MBTI.

In experiments on the BigFive and MBTI models, PysAttention achieved average accuracy of 65.66% and 86.30%, respectively, outperforming state-of-the-art methods, indicating that it is effective at encoding psychological features.
